# FIA AI Framework Monorepo

This is a TypeScript monorepo containing multiple AI libraries and frameworks.

## Structure
- **packages/** - Contains all library packages
- **apps/** - Contains applications
- **tools/** - Contains build tools and utilities

## Libraries
- @fia/core - Core interfaces and types
- @fia/runtime - Execution runtime
- @fia/mundo - World and data domains
- @fia/search-algorithms - Search algorithms
- @fia/machine-learning - Machine learning components  
- @fia/grammars - Grammar systems and dictionaries
- @fia/expert-systems - Knowledge-based systems
- @fia/neural-networks - Neural network implementations
- @fia/devops - DevOps utilities
- @fia/i18n - Internationalization

## Applications
- @fia/launcher - Thread launcher application

## Development
Uses npm workspaces for package management.
TypeScript compilation with shared tsconfig.
